title: Bounded probabilistic test
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean symbols, let $c,B,e$ be natural numbers, and let $x$ be a Boolean string. The test returns whether the binary encoding of $2^{Be}$ paired with the weighted acceptance string, preceded by a zero bit, is less than the specified binary encoding comparison bound.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean symbols
caveat: The precise meanings of the pairing, weighted acceptance string, power construction, and binary comparison operation are not defined in this payload.
